steps.check: Find the historical lab and exact image
steps.actual: Docker showed a running historical IMP-02 node and the matching tagless Kind node image.

steps.check: Start the leased node on an internal bridge
steps.actual: Kind boot did not reach multi-user state. The retained node exited 2 and iptables-restore reported an empty host or network.

steps.check: Start a separate owned bridge with a gateway
steps.actual: The new Kind control plane booted with an API published only on loopback.

steps.check: Import Calico images from the earlier cache
steps.actual: The cached archive lacked a referenced content layer. The three exact pinned arm64 image digests were fetched into the new node.

steps.check: Apply pinned Calico and load the current package image
steps.actual: Node reached Ready. The local IMP-10 image ID matched its retained smoke receipt and Kind loaded it.
Docker image inspection timed out. The leased node showed OOMKilled=true. The CRI handshake and Kubernetes API timed out.

steps.check: Restart the leased node and retry readiness
steps.actual: The same node eventually returned Ready. The four probe pods did not become ready in the next run, and the temporary network-control container was observed Dead.

steps.check: Run same-target CNI controls and stop a healthy loaded node
steps.actual: Probe pod readiness timed out before either check began.
Kind removed the leased node and Docker removed the empty leased bridge. The probe was gone and the empty owned kubeconfig was removed.
